items.source: Return the selected String view name or View object.
items.translation: 返回选定的 `String` 视图名称或 `View` 对象。

items.source: Create a new builder for a redirect through a RedirectView.
items.translation: 为通过 `RedirectView` 进行重定向创建一个新构建器。

items.source: Controllers typically return a String view name and rely on the "implicit" model which can also be injected into the controller method. Or controllers may return model attribute(s) and rely on a default view name being selected based on the request path.
items.translation: 控制器通常返回一个 String 视图名称，并依赖也可以注入到控制器方法中的“隐式”模型。或者，控制器可以返回模型属性，并依赖根据请求路径选择默认视图名称。

items.source: Rendering can be used to combine a view name with model attributes, set the HTTP status or headers, and for other more advanced options around redirect scenarios.
items.translation: Rendering 可用于将视图名称与模型属性组合，设置 HTTP 状态或标头，以及用于重定向场景的其他更高级选项。

items.source: Return headers to add to the response.
items.translation: 返回要添加到响应中的标头。

items.source: Return attributes to add to the model.
items.translation: 返回要添加到模型的属性。

items.source: Return the HTTP status to set the response to.
items.translation: 返回以设置响应的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source: Create a new builder for response rendering based on the given view name.
items.translation: 基于给定的视图名称创建一个新的响应渲染构建器。

items.source: name - the view name to be resolved to a View
items.translation: name - 要解析为View的视图名称

items.source: Defines a builder for Rendering.
items.translation: 定义一个用于构建Rendering的构建器。

items.source: Extends Rendering.Builder with extra options for redirect scenarios.
items.translation: 扩展Rendering.Builder，为重定向场景提供额外选项。
